page.layout: One block of text in a single column, centred; running head "EPISTOLA." at the top; a printer's ornament at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: morúmque elegantia ornatissi-mo: cuius si consiliis & monitis, facilem (q iod te facere res ipsa o-stendit) au em præbueris, non du-bito, quin Deo fauente, familiæ tuę magno sis futurus ornamento, & Patriæ columen.

page.notes: The line "Vale" is set in larger type and is treated as a closing word. The ornament at the foot is a printer's device. Doubtful readings: "q iod" (quod, with a blank after q), "au em" (autem, with a gap), "iteium" (iterum), and the ornament mark, which is transcribed as a symbol. The date is printed as CIↃ. IↃ. XCVIII., i.e. MDXCVIII.
